title: Welch unequal-variance two-sample t-test: mean difference = 0.50
assumptions: Independent observations and approximately normal outcomes within each group.
The planned analysis is Welch's unequal-variance t-test, with a raw mean difference and one SD for each group.
The analytic value is a Welch-Satterthwaite noncentral-t planning approximation; the independent simulation applies the actual unequal-variance test.
